events.description: Render the base stacked probability distribution segments representing the probability of each event.
events.clip_query: A horizontal bar divided into segments of varying widths representing a probability distribution.

events.description: Render vertical information bars above each probability segment, with heights proportional to negative log-probability.
events.clip_query: Vertical bars of varying heights standing on top of horizontal segments, colored in a blue-to-teal gradient.

events.description: Display horizontal reference grid lines and numerical labels indicating information bits on the vertical axis.
events.clip_query: Horizontal grid lines with integer labels showing information bits next to the vertical bars.

events.description: Animate a dynamic transition where the probability distribution shifts, causing the segments and information bars to resize and reposition smoothly.
events.clip_query: The widths of the horizontal segments and the heights of the vertical bars changing dynamically and smoothly.
